surface: src/plate_core/plate_config.py, src/plate_core/health.py, gh plate config validate/show, gh plate health
summary: Treat a .plate/ directory as an unrecognized layout: clear PlateConfigError, non-zero CLI exits without traceback, and health no longer reports MISSING.
migration_impact: Repos with a legacy .plate/ folder see actionable errors pointing at gh plate bootstrap --adopt --apply and docs/migration/adoption-guide.md instead of IsADirectoryError or MISSING.
migration_guidance: 1. Back up files under .plate/, remove or rename the directory.
agent_notes: plate-core expects a single JSON file at .plate; use get_plate_config_report or plate_directory_layout_error_message() for the canonical text.
